remarks: Experience luxury living at its finest in this stunning penthouse condo, where every detail has been meticulously crafted. This exquisite residence boasts high-end finishes throughout, including a gourmet kitchen equipped with a Sub-Zero refrigerator, all set against the backdrop of sleek hardwood floors that flow seamlessly through the open living space.  The living area is an entertainer's dream, featuring vaulted ceilings that create an airy, open ambiance, a cozy wood-burning fireplace, and a custom-built bookcase perfect for showcasing your collections. Step out onto the private terrace to take in breathtaking harbor views and enjoy the serenity of spectacular sunsets from the comfort of your own home.  The 2nd-floor primary suite is a true retreat, offering privacy and tranquility, with ample space for relaxation and rejuvenation.  Outside, the charm continues with beautifully manicured flower gardens perfect for a leisurely stroll, and a private storage unit provides additional convenience. Just steps away, you'll find parks and two pristine beaches, making this penthouse not just a home, but a lifestyle. Don't miss the opportunity to own this exceptional property, where luxury meets location.
